isolation.directory_guard: every concrete discovery directory must stay under synthetic HOME

limitations: Single machine, single Python/Textual build; numbers are not a portable release target.
capture_ms measures the capture worker only (wrapped capture_session); mount/compose overhead is excluded from it but included in both startup_to_* figures.

publication_to_rows_populated_ms spans accepted capture on the UI thread to the end of the instrumented Home rebuild that first carries every row, before Textual lays out and paints. publication_to_first_usable_ms spans the same start to a benchmark-only callback scheduled with call_after_refresh, which runs after the screen has been refreshed; that is the figure to read as time-until-usable. Both are wall-clock on the shared event loop and include worker/message scheduling.
The injected-delay run demonstrates the publication-to-first-usable interval tracks real work; the requested delay is 50.0 ms.

per_cell_update_ms is the real cost of one Home state-cell update. amortized_queue_ms_per_resolved_row is the whole serial queue wall time divided by resolved rows: it folds together snapshot_why worker execution, worker/message scheduling, the per-group Home cell updates and their redraws. The harness does not attribute the total to any one of those components.

active_navigation_ms/active_filter_ms/active_quit_ms are measured while hundreds of resolutions are still pending (the probe records pending_at_start and pending_before_quit). Navigation and quit use real Pilot key presses; the filter is driven through the Input's Changed event because Pilot's press waits for the app to drain and would outlast the queue. That Input.Changed path is not a physical key press, so no physical key-to-paint latency is claimed for the filter figure. Navigating, filtering and the queued re-drive all leave that probe unsuitable for the why_call/group equality assertion.

The superseded schema-2 receipt docs/validation/u3/implementation/historical/benchmark-home-r2.json labelled its row-population boundary 'publication_to_first_list_ms' and described it as laid out/paint; that wording was too strong. It is preserved as history, not relabelled valid, and is superseded by this schema-3 receipt, which separates row population from post-refresh usability.

The superseded receipt docs/validation/u3/implementation/historical/benchmark-home-r1.json is invalid and unsafe (its sandbox was cleared after run 1, so later runs allowed absolute system roots, and its publication boundary measured a near-zero predicate check). It is preserved as history and is not relabelled valid.
